en: Sepia-toned photograph of a commemorative stone in an open field or meadow. The stone bears the number "1345" painted in white on its face and is decorated with wreaths or garlands of foliage and evergreen branches draped over and around it. In the background are gently rolling fields with scattered trees and a young, newly planted tree supported by stakes to the right. The scene is rural and somber, suggesting a memorial or historical marker.
